name: Austral-Donjon
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around towering mountain ranges, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in copper here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
